units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:2:2">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᶜ</cite> the order of confession is <he>עוו פשעו חטאו</he> in order not to mention <he>גִּנּוּיָין של ישראל</he> the shame of Israel (by bringing the name of Israel in direct connection with <he>פשעו</he> as the harshest of the three expressions).
